verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a pay-run comparison feature to catch discrepancies before approval (rippling-docs-1) and offers general developer APIs/sandbox for building custom integrations (rippling-docs-8, rippling-docs-43), which could theoretically support an agent-driven payroll preview workflow. However, there is no evidence of a specific payroll preview API endpoint, anomaly-surfacing mechanism accessible programmatically, or any agent/AI integration example for this exact workflow. Missing for 10: a documented payroll preview API endpoint, anomaly-detection API output format, and any evidence of an agent actually using the API to run a preview and flag anomalies before approval.
